title: Better visibility into your automation credit consumption
description:
To help you prepare for upcoming billing changes, we’ve redesigned the Usage tab in Automation. This update gives you more visibility into your usage patterns and helps you identify which automation rules contribute most to your Automation steps and Rovo credits consumption. To view this change: Open your Atlassian app, such as Jira or Confluence.
	Navigate to Automation.
	Select the Usage tab to view the refreshed usage dashboard.
